# KP Front

> KP Front is an open-source, self-hosted digital incident-command application for fire brigades. It combines a shared situation map, building and pre-incident plans, team management, breathing-apparatus monitoring, a water-relay calculation with automatic pump placement, an append-only incident log, shift planning, reporting and incident replay.

## Canonical website pages

- German (default): https://kp-front.ch/
- French: https://kp-front.ch/fr/
- Italian: https://kp-front.ch/it/
- Romansh: https://kp-front.ch/rm/
- English: https://kp-front.ch/en/

## Product facts

- The application is developed from operational use at Feuerwehr Oberwil BL.
- Each fire brigade runs its own installation and controls its own incident data.
- The application is licensed under AGPL-3.0.
- The application interface is available in German, French, Italian and English. German is the authoritative version; the other three have not yet been proofread by firefighters.
- External integrations such as alarm intake, GPS, weather services, map services, transcription and Microsoft sign-in are optional.
- The website is available in German, French, Italian, Romansh and English.
